text: Bit worn out so forgive the message. Granddaughter is 11, temp came out at 39.9 I think, did it twice. She's got a reddish rash, I pressed a glass on it and it goes pale so I believe that's the less worrying sort? Also a few itchy bites on her legs, midges probably, she keeps scratching them. Her breathing seems fine to me, normal, and she's been to the loo for wees like usual. Not sure if I'm meant to bring her somewhere at that temperature or just carry on with medicine and fluids. Long day.
